notes.title: Thalassic Dice Dev Update #1
notes.notes:
Ahoy! 



It's been a busy few weeks since announcing Thalassic Dice and I'd like to thank everyone for the kind words and excitement for the game! 



I've been hard at work focusing on implementing feedback that I got after launching the steam page, so here's some highlights from that! 
Dev Log[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45644942/3d8e7e319ba5226c092a7baf75a42fd92d0bac42.gif"]
I've focused a lot on visual effects, improving how the game looks and adding some much needed movement!

Screen Shake + damage particles when the ship takes damage

Weather Effects (snow, rain, heat distortion, etc. )

Added some movement to the Sails of the Ship

I've updated the die model and textures to better fit the visual theme. 

Also working on some other things I'm not quite ready to talk about yet! But keep an eye out here for more updates! 



All of the changes can be seen in the updated gameplay trailer:
[previewyoutube="4ljBRvdgMeI;full"][/previewyoutube]




Bonus: I got some good music inspiration by going to a really good jazz concert featuring Mischa Blanos & Anthony Gutierrez and Chico Freeman - Reto Weber Duo which I highly recommend. (no, there unfortunately won't be any actual jazz in Thalassic Dice)



Calm Seas,

TidalDog
